    • withNamespace

      public CreateJustification withNamespace(String ns)
      Description copied from interface: Command
      This command, read from a file loaded under namespace ns: every model name it holds is qualified by ns, and every qualified element id too (see QualifiedIds.inNamespace(String, String)); a plain element id, a label or a type is unchanged. Each command type states how it is namespaced, so that none escapes the namespace silently. A command the compiler creates while building the unit is never read from a file, and refuses.
